3. **Hidden Elements Check** - Examination of aria-labels, data attributes, and screen reader text that might be visible

4. **Targeted Fix** - Removal of the duplicate label source while preserving the correct h3 crimson title

5. **Comprehensive Validation** - Testing against the reference design and verifying all functionality works correctly

- **IMAGE** → **h3 crimson title** "Name · Description" → **p gray cardDescription**
